summary: Generac Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing a September 16, 2026 Transaction Agreement with Amazon.com and issuance to Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC of a warrant for up to 1,693,745 common shares at $200.9266 per share. Only 307,954 warrant shares vested immediately; the balance vests in tranches tied to up to $8 billion of aggregate gross payments to Generac for Amazon data-center backup generators. A long-term supply agreement accompanies the warrant, with initial deliveries expected to total $2.4 billion across 2027-2028. The warrant is exercisable through September 16, 2033, cash or cashless, with registration rights and anti-dilution adjustments; issued under Section 4(a)(2). Watch Amazon payment milestones, vesting cadence, and dilution/overhang.
